title: Model class and subclass feature option catalogs
description:
Problem:
Several class/subclass features are present as parent records but their gameplay options are prose only. The primary DM model can sometimes discover them via full-text retrieval, but deterministic character creation cannot enumerate, validate, persist, or apply them.

Goal:
Introduce a schema-visible representation for feature option catalogs and connect them to the parent feature choices.

Design expectations:
- Options should be addressable by stable ids.
- Options should carry source text and source location.
- Options should expose prerequisites where the SRD states them.
- Parent features should link to their option catalogs through structured choices.
- Effects may start prose-backed, but the selected option must be persistable and queryable.
- Preserve source fidelity; do not invent non-SRD effects.

Acceptance criteria:
- Option catalogs are represented consistently for class/subclass build choices.
- Parent feature records expose deterministic choices that reference the option catalogs.
- Character creation code can enumerate legal options without parsing prose.
- Choice-coverage audit has no findings for the modeled option families.
- Existing pack verification and importer tests pass.
close_reason: Completed all child option-catalog and spell-filter modeling in one PR
